title: Detailed laptop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- laptop base / keyboard deck - bottom half, angled perspective -->
  <polygon points='10,72 90,72 82,88 18,88' fill='#8899AA' stroke='#AABBC8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- front edge highlight -->
  <polygon points='18,88 82,88 80,91 20,91' fill='#667788'/>
  <!-- keyboard area -->
  <polygon points='18,74 82,74 78,85 22,85' fill='#334455'/>
  <!-- keys row 1 -->
  <rect x='22' y='76' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='46' y='76' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='54' y='76' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='62' y='76' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='70' y='76' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <!-- keys row 2 -->
  <rect x='22' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='30' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='38' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='46' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='54' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='62' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <rect x='70' y='81' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#CCDDEE'/>
  <!-- trackpad -->
  <rect x='40' y='86' width='20' height='3' rx='1' fill='#556677'/>

  <!-- screen half - raised, bezel -->
  <polygon points='12,18 88,18 92,72 8,72' fill='#778899' stroke='#99AABB' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- inner bezel shaded -->
  <polygon points='16,23 84,23 87,67 13,67' fill='#556677'/>
  <!-- screen display area -->
  <polygon points='19,27 81,27 83,63 17,63' fill='#33AACC'/>
  <!-- screen content: window -->
  <polygon points='25,32 75,32 76,58 24,58' fill='#44CCEE'/>
  <!-- title bar -->
  <polygon points='25,32 75,32 75,37 25,37' fill='#2277AA'/>
  <!-- window buttons -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='34.5' r='1.5' fill='#FF6666'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='34.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFCC44'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='34.5' r='1.5' fill='#55DD88'/>
  <!-- text lines on screen -->
  <rect x='28' y='41' width='30' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='28' y='46' width='40' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='28' y='51' width='25' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- cursor arrow -->
  <polygon points='60,47 60,54 63,52 65,56 67,55 65,51 68,50' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- hinge -->
  <rect x='14' y='70' width='72' height='3' rx='1' fill='#AABBC8'/>

  <!-- subtle screen glow reflection -->
  <polygon points='19,27 40,27 35,63 17,63' fill='#66DDFF' opacity='0.15'/>
</svg>
